title: Fraela
dedication: Most Auspicious Serene Omnipotence Fraela Syvelle
intro: Happy birthday, my love. Of the thousand photos from this year, these are the ones I would frame. Scroll slowly.

chapters.title: In bloom
chapters.message: Sunflowers spend their whole lives turning toward the light. Standing next to you, I finally understood them.

photos.caption: Sunflowers, and the softest smile.
photos.alt: Fraela in her school uniform, smiling over a bouquet of sunflowers wrapped in pink paper

photos.caption: Closer. The flowers never stood a chance.
photos.alt: Close portrait of Fraela beside a large sunflower bouquet

photos.caption: Arms full of flowers, chocolates and medals. You earned every one.
photos.alt: Fraela in her school uniform with medals, holding a box of chocolates and a purple bouquet

photos.caption: Even your school portrait belongs in a frame.
photos.alt: Formal school portrait of Fraela in a white blouse, navy vest and red necktie

chapters.title: Sage and stone
chapters.message: Old stone walls and a green dress. Those walls have stood for centuries, and I still think that afternoon was the best thing they have seen.

photos.caption: Every arch looked better with you in it.
photos.alt: Fraela in a sage-green dress standing in a weathered stone archway

photos.caption: Window light, cool stone and you.
photos.alt: Fraela in a sage-green dress beside a window in an old stone wall

photos.caption: At the end of the tunnel, there you were.
photos.alt: Fraela in a sage-green dress in a brick tunnel lit from behind

photos.caption: Old church, new favorite photo.
photos.alt: Fraela in a sage-green dress in front of a centuries-old stone church

photos.caption: A quiet seat under the trees.
photos.alt: Fraela in a sage-green dress sitting on a park bench under spreading trees

photos.caption: Cobblestones and a green dress. A postcard I get to keep.
photos.alt: Fraela in a sage-green dress on a cobblestone street lined with old houses

chapters.title: Golden night
chapters.message: You wore gold, and the whole city lit up behind you. I have never wanted to stop time so badly.

photos.caption: Curls, sparkle and that smile.
photos.alt: Close portrait of Fraela in a sequined gold gown and a diamond necklace

photos.caption: The curtain call.
photos.alt: Fraela in a gold gown and white fur stole, standing before a plum curtain

photos.caption: The skyline came second.
photos.alt: Fraela in a gold gown leaning on a terrace railing with the city skyline at night

photos.caption: A look over your shoulder, and I was done for.
photos.alt: Fraela in a gold gown looking back over her shoulder in front of a plum curtain

photos.caption: Fit for a portrait hall.
photos.alt: Fraela in a gold gown and fur stole seated on a leather sofa

photos.caption: Fur, city lights and steady eyes.
photos.alt: Fraela in a gold gown and fur stole on a terrace at night, city lights behind her

photos.caption: Halfway through dinner and still glowing.
photos.alt: Close portrait of Fraela in a gold gown at a dinner table

photos.caption: Gold on gold.
photos.alt: Fraela in a shimmering gold gown, turned in profile before a dark curtain

photos.caption: Every light in the city, and I only saw you.
photos.alt: Fraela in a gold gown and fur stole on a night terrace beneath the skyline

chapters.title: In white
chapters.message: A white dress, a wide blue sky and a garden that went on forever. If anyone asks me what happiness looks like, I will show them this.

photos.caption: Arms crossed, smile winning anyway.
photos.alt: Fraela in a white dress with arms crossed in front of tall bookshelves

photos.caption: Surrounded by stories, and still the best one in the room.
photos.alt: Fraela in a white dress smiling beside bookshelves and a framed painting

photos.caption: Waiting at the window.
photos.alt: Fraela resting her chin in her hands at an open capiz-shell window

photos.caption: A path lined with flowers, and you at the end of it.
photos.alt: Fraela in a white dress on a stone path through a flower garden under a palm tree

photos.caption: Sunlight, shade and you in between.
photos.alt: Fraela in a white dress under a wooden garden shelter on a sunny day

photos.caption: Arms open, like the whole garden was yours.
photos.alt: Fraela in a white dress with arms open on a garden path under a blue sky

film.title: The film
film.note: These photographs, set in motion to Last Night on Earth by Green Day. It starts on its own without sound, so press Play with sound to hear it.
notification: Happy birthday, my love. Tap to open.

closing.title: Happy birthday, Most Auspicious Serene Omnipotence Fraela Syvelle
closing.message: Thank you for this year: for the dressed-up nights, and for the ordinary afternoons that felt just as special. I can't wait to fill the next album with you.
